newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian-Belarussian oil firm has new cat reformer.
newsitem.headline: Russian-Belarussian oil firm has new cat reformer.

text.p: Russian-Belarussian oil company Slavneft said on Tuesday that a newly reconstructed catalytic reformer at its Mozyrsky refinery would increase production of gasoline.

A company news release said that running the reformer at its capacity of one million tonnes a year (20,000 barrels per day) would increase gasoline output by 130,000 tonnes a year (2,600 bpd) without raising the volume of oil refined.
The reformer, commissioned late last month, is part of a $165 million modernisation plan for the refinery, which is located in the south-central part of the former Soviet republic of Belarus.
Mozyrsky refined 5.32 million tonnes (106,400 bpd) of oil in 1996, down from 5.63 million tonnes (112,600 bpd) in 1995.
